installCommand: if grep -q 'data:text/javascript;base64' index.html 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Standalone index.html gedetecteerd'; else npm install --include=dev; fi
buildCommand: if grep -q 'data:text/javascript;base64' index.html 2>/dev/null; then mkdir -p dist && ([ -d public ] && cp -r public/* dist/ || true) && cp index.html dist/index.html; else if [ ! -x node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then npm install --include=dev; fi && ./node_modules/.bin/vite build; fi
